name: Nuclear-to-Cytoplasmic Fluorescence Ratio Measurement
description:
Measure the nuclear-to-cytoplasmic (N/C) fluorescence intensity ratio for at least 3 individual cells in the 'Fluorescent Cells' sample image using Fiji (ImageJ). 

1. Open the 'Fluorescent Cells' sample (File > Open Samples > Fluorescent Cells).
2. Split the channels (Image > Color > Split Channels) to separate the Blue (nuclei), Green (signal), and Red channels.
3. For at least 3 distinct cells:
   - Use the Blue channel to identify the nucleus and draw a 'Nuclear' ROI.
   - Draw a corresponding 'Cytoplasmic' ROI for the same cell (region outside the nucleus but within the cell).
   - Measure the Mean Intensity of the **Green channel** for both the Nuclear and Cytoplasmic ROIs.
4. Calculate the N/C Ratio (Mean Nuclear Intensity / Mean Cytoplasmic Intensity) for each cell.
5. Save a results table containing the Nuclear Mean, Cytoplasmic Mean, and N/C Ratio for each cell to `~/ImageJ_Data/results/nc_ratio_results.csv`.

The output file must contain labeled columns for these measurements.
